card.name: Gap before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word that comes right before a dose number after an injectable antibiotic name (e.g. 'Daptomycin' then '6 mg/kg'). It also fires on 'the' or 'non' in phrases like 'members of the ... class'.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: A bare space after an injectable drug name, just before the strength or dose figure.

modes.label: Linking word in class phrases
modes.description: 'the' or 'non' just before a drug class name in contraindication or interaction wording.
modes.example: or other members of<< the>> beta-lactam class.

card.plain: It fires on the small gap or joining word just before a dose amount or drug class name in antibiotic labels.
